newsitem.title: POLAND: NKT Cables calls tender for Kable shares.
newsitem.headline: NKT Cables calls tender for Kable shares.

text.p: Denmark's NKT Cables has called a public tender offer for one million shares of Polish cable maker Kable SA at 27.9 zlotys per share, the Warsaw bourse said in a statement on Wednesday.
The statement also said NKT Cables wanted to announce another tender for 500,000 shares of Kable, which would give it a 100 percent control of the firm.
Kable, in which NKT has currently a 25-percent stake, has two million shares oustanding.
Kable's current shareholders will be able to subscribe to sell the shares from February 27 to March 28, the statement said.
The bourse also said it suspended trade on Kable on Thursday, following the tender announcement.
Kable traded at 39.9 zlotys on Wednesday.
